```{r}

threshold <- 0.5

# First calculate accuracy within each independent unit

accuracy_by_unit <- valideringsdata %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  # Fjern bekkeåpninger siden det er for få observasjoner
  filter(kriteriekart != "bekkapninger") %>%
  group_by(kriteriekart, SSBID) %>%
  summarise(
    n_points = n(),
    correct = sum(TP),
    accuracy = mean(TP),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Then summarize across SSBID × naturtype units
accuracy_results <- accuracy_by_unit %>%
  group_by(kriteriekart) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_accuracy = mean(accuracy),
    sd_accuracy = sd(accuracy),
    se_accuracy = sd(accuracy) / sqrt(n),
    lower = mean_accuracy - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se_accuracy,
    upper = mean_accuracy + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se_accuracy,
    p_value = t.test(
      accuracy,
      mu = threshold,
      alternative = "greater"
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lower = pmax(0, lower),
    upper = pmin(1, upper),
    significant = if_else(
      p_value < 0.05,
      "Significant (p < 0.05)",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )



p <- ggplot(
  accuracy_results,
  aes(
    x = reorder(kriteriekart, mean_accuracy),
    y = mean_accuracy,
    shape = significant
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = threshold,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3, aes(group = significant, col = significant)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(NinaR::nina_colors[[2]], NinaR::nina_colors[[3]])) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = reorder(kriteriekart, mean_accuracy),
      y = 1.03,
      label = paste0("n = ", n)
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  #geom_text(
  #  aes(
  #    y = upper + 0.03,
  #    label = if_else(
  #      significant == "Significant",
  #      "*",
  #      "ns"
  #    )
  #  ),
  #  hjust = -0.8,
  #  size = 4
  #) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
    labels = function(x) {
      ifelse(x <= 1, scales::percent(x), "")
    }
  ) +
  labs(
    x = " ",
    y = "Accuracy",
    shape = NULL#,
    #caption = "* p < 0.05; ns = not significant"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 40, 5.5, 5.5)
  ) +
  guides(shape="none")

ggsave(
  filename = "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Resultater/Validering/accuracy_by_class_25_26_data.png",
```
